measurements.evidence_quote: Surface charge measurements conducted using Dynamic Light Scattering (DLS) revealed that all nanoparticles exhibited strongly negative zeta potentials: -40.02 ± 2.41 mV for PS-NPs, -34.98 ± 1.98 mV for HDPE-NPs, and -32.23 ± 3.92 mV for Ag-NPs/PS-NPs mixture. || Zeta potential and polydispersity index measurements were carried out at 25 °C in a DTS 1067 capillary cell using a Zetasizer NanoZS instrument (Malvern, UK). Before measurement, the working solution was diluted at a ratio of 1:8 with deionized water. || Table 1. Characteristics of nanoparticles (measured in deionized water)18–20.
